blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano floated the idea of allowing “generous” Filipinos to voluntarily donate P170,598.03 each to pay for the national government debt. Cayetano raised the proposal during the Senate’s deliberations on the proposed 2027 national budget on Monday, after discussing the country’s debt of P19.66 trillion as of the third quarter of this year.
